- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20084 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: When the issue-state lookup fails, ISSUE_STATE defaults to "open", so the healer treats an unreadable or closed issue as confirmed open and proceeds with label and state changes.
  WHY: A transient API failure can cause a closed issue with stale merged state and a rejected linked PR to be re-entered as active instead of following the alert-only path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15820-15835 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The healer changes GitHub labels before rewriting the state file, and continues with the healed labels if the state-file rewrite fails.
  WHY: check-wave-status can prioritize the unchanged stored terminal "merged" status over the healed labels and rejected-PR signal, allowing the wave to advance before the next-cycle retry; one reviewer rated this nit rather than major.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15293 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Early validation failures in _pr_json_merged_into_issue_target can leave ISSUE_TARGET_MERGE_REJECT_REASON set to "non_target_base", causing callers to log a misleading rejection reason.
  WHY: Operators may investigate a target-branch mismatch when the actual cause is malformed or missing input; reviewers agree the gate remains correct and this is a diagnostics-only issue.

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- file: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  location: lines 15303 and 15321
  issue: Repository slug comparisons between PR JSON (.base.repo.full_name, .head.repo.full_name) and GITHUB_REPOSITORY in _pr_json_merged_into_issue_target are case-sensitive string equality checks. Although typical slugs are consistent in casing, GitHub treats owner/repo paths case-insensitively.
  suggested minimal fix: Convert repository slug values to lowercase (for example using tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') before equality checks.
  estimated lines changed: 4

- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The linked issue #5618 recommends "Apply the same fail-closed target-branch and identity checks before supplying merged PR state to label reconciliation and wave status." The round-2 consensus identified that prior-wave children whose ai:merged label or stored merged status was written by a vulnerable poll cycle before this rule shipped remain unremediated.
  Expected change site: _heal_rejected_merged_state or the backward-scan promotion block in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Evidence of absence: The heal call in the current-wave reconcile loop is scoped to WAVE_IDX (current wave only). The backward-scan block logs `rejected=<reason>` and continues without calling any heal helper. The owner decision Q11 A on PR #5633 explicitly scopes the heal to "open current-wave children only," and the project log records this as a documented scope decision. Prior-wave children with stale ai:merged from a pre-fix wrong-base merge keep their label and stored terminal status until close_merged_issues_sweep (which already applies the target-branch rule) or a future reconcile cycle corrects them. This is a documented deferral (Q11 A), not an omission — the close sweep prevents incorrect closure, but the wave-status signal can still read "merged" from stored state in the interim.
  severity=NIT, confidence=3

=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
